rule.title: React Hook Form Combined with Zod Schema Resolver
rule.statement: All forms must be managed with React Hook Form and validated against a shared Zod schema using @hookform/resolvers/zod.
rule.rationale: Manual useState form management causes unnecessary re-renders on every keystroke and leads to duplicate validation logic between client and server.
rule.implementation_guidance: useForm({ resolver: zodResolver(schema) }). Disable submit button while formState.isSubmitting is true.

forbidden.example: Managing 10 separate useState hooks for form inputs with manual regex checks in an onSubmit handler.

preferred.example: const { register, handleSubmit, formState } = useForm({ resolver: zodResolver(loginSchema) });

source.book_title: Learn React with TypeScript - Third Edition
source.evidence_quote: Using React Hook Form with Zod schemas ensures type-safe forms with minimal re-renders and aligns frontend validation directly with backend contracts.
